name: climate__setpoint_via_engine
description: Thermostat cluster (0x0201) attribute OccupiedHeatingSetpoint (0x0012) on endpoint 5 emits ReportData on a fresh bridge-initiated exchange when the subscription engine drains a dirty mark. Extends the cluster-coverage matrix for F4 into the HVAC domain: a thermostat setpoint change arriving from the CCU must not reuse the Subscribe exchange regardless of cluster family.
